property_summary: Scheduling an operation with delay at least the minimum delay records a nonzero timestamp strictly greater than 1, so the operation is not ready at scheduling time.
After scheduling an operation with delay at least the minimum delay, its timestamp is greater than 1 and the operation is not ready at scheduling time.
Scheduling an operation with delay at least the minimum delay records a timestamp greater than 1, so the operation is not immediately ready.
Scheduling an operation with delay >= minDelay sets its timestamp strictly greater than 1, so it is not immediately ready.
After a successful schedule, isOperation is true and the timestamp equals block.timestamp plus the given delay.
If an operation is successfully cancelled, it is no longer an operation (isOperation returns false) and its timestamp becomes zero.
